evals.prompt: Can you sort this `Life Admin/` dump into the right PARA places? Files: `tax-2026-filing.md`, `tax-2024-return.pdf`, `monthly-budget-review.md`, `mortgage-refinance-options.md`, `article-notes-about-index-funds.md`, `receipt-scan-unknown-date.pdf`, `weekly-review-template.md`, `passport-renewal-2026.md`, `fitness-routine.md`, and `old-car-sale-docs-2023.md`.
evals.expected_output: Adds a structured PARA routing recommendation even though the user did not request structure, including confidence, assumptions/open questions, next actions, and Inbox for unclear items.
expectations: Provides a structured routing table or equivalent clearly labeled mapping with destination, confidence, reason, and next action.
Routes active finite outcomes `tax-2026-filing.md`, `mortgage-refinance-options.md`, and `passport-renewal-2026.md` to Projects.
Routes ongoing responsibilities `monthly-budget-review.md` and active `fitness-routine.md` to Areas or explicitly flags fitness as ambiguous if it may be a time-boxed challenge.
Routes reusable reference/template material `article-notes-about-index-funds.md` and `weekly-review-template.md` to Resources.
Routes historical/completed records `tax-2024-return.pdf` and `old-car-sale-docs-2023.md` to Archives.
Routes `receipt-scan-unknown-date.pdf` to Inbox or a triage holding area instead of forcing a permanent category.
States assumptions or open questions and avoids claiming that files were moved.

evals.prompt: A friend says my folders are too many and I should move `09-System/automation-routing-rules.md`, `05-Daily/2026-06-03.md`, and `03-Resources/templates/weekly-review-template.md` into Resources. Is that right?
evals.expected_output: Rejects the oversimplification and preserves local support layers even though the user did not explicitly list all folder rules.
expectations: Does not endorse moving all three files into Resources.
Keeps `09-System/automation-routing-rules.md` in System or an equivalent system/administration layer.
Keeps `05-Daily/2026-06-03.md` in Daily or an equivalent chronological capture layer.
Keeps `03-Resources/templates/weekly-review-template.md` in Resources because it is a reusable template.
Explains that PARA should respect current use and local support layers, not only whether something is knowledge.

evals.prompt: Help me clean up `Writing/`: current book proposal due next month, ongoing newsletter checklist, headline examples, completed 2023 essay contest notes, random clipped quotes with no source, and a general writing-style guide.
evals.expected_output: Turns a vague cleanup request into a safe migration plan, splits by actionability, and includes safety checks before bulk moves.
expectations: Splits `Writing/` by actionability instead of keeping everything under one topic folder.
Routes the current book proposal to Projects.
Routes the ongoing newsletter checklist to Areas.
Routes headline examples and the writing-style guide to Resources, or explicitly flags the style guide as Area if it is a maintained standard.
Routes completed 2023 essay contest notes to Archives.
Routes random clipped quotes with no source to Inbox or triage instead of permanent Resources.
Includes migration safety guidance such as confirmation questions, index/backlink updates, verification, or rollback notes.
Does not perform moves and makes clear that bulk changes need confirmation.
